cases.name: Fukuko Kusakari
cases.narrative:
Her naked body was lying face up on the bedroom floor, in a pool of blood. There was a black plastic trash bag around her neck. Another plastic trash bag was on the floor near her right foot. Both bags were bloodstained. There was a bloody knife near her feet.

The autopsy showed she had sustained 15 stab wounds to the central and left sides of her upper torso and abdominal area. There were 7 stab wounds in her back. She had defensive wounds on the palm of her right hand, consistent with her having tried to grab the knife. She had died within minutes of the stabbing and there were no postmortem wounds.

cases.name: Whitney Jade Washuta
